steps.title: CrashLoopBackOff Exit Code & Crash Log Analysis
steps.description: Investigate a failing background service that crashes immediately upon boot. Extract previous container exit codes and identify the root cause stack trace.
tasks: Create a simulated crashing microservice script: `/home/student/incident-war-room/crash_app.sh` that exits with code 1 due to missing `DATABASE_URL`

Create an incident triage script: `/home/student/incident-war-room/triage_crash.sh` that checks if `DATABASE_URL` is set, sets a default if missing, and logs `REPAIRED` to `/home/student/incident-war-room/repair.log`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/incident-war-room/triage_crash.sh && test -x /home/student/incident-war-room/triage_crash.sh && /home/student/incident-war-room/triage_crash.sh && grep -q 'REPAIRED' /home/student/incident-war-room/repair.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Memory Leak & OOM Killer Hunting with pmap and ps
steps.description: Simulate a runaway process consuming resident memory. Inspect memory segment allocations and write an automated watchdog to terminate leaking PIDs before host starvation.
tasks: Create an automated memory watchdog script: `/home/student/incident-war-room/memory_watchdog.sh`
Make it scan for any process consuming > 200MB resident set size (`rss`) using `ps -eo pid,rss,comm`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/incident-war-room/memory_watchdog.sh && /home/student/incident-war-room/memory_watchdog.sh && test -f /home/student/incident-war-room/oom_prevented.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: CoreDNS Timeout & ndots Optimization
steps.description: Diagnose latency degradation caused by DNS resolution retries. Optimize resolv.conf configurations and verify query resolution timings.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/incident-war-room/resolv_optimized.conf && grep -q 'nameserver' /home/student/incident-war-room/resolv_optimized.conf && grep -q 'options timeout' /home/student/incident-war-room/resolv_optimized.conf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Authoring an SRE Post-Mortem Incident Report
steps.description: Generate an executive-ready Markdown Root Cause Analysis (RCA) document documenting the incident timeline, impact, root cause, and 5 action items.
tasks: Include sections: `## Incident Overview`, `## Timeline (UTC)`, `## Root Cause (5 Whys)`, and `## Action Items (Preventative)`
Include calculated MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) under 15 minutes

verification.command: test -f /home/student/incident-war-room/POST_MORTEM.md && grep -q 'Root Cause' /home/student/incident-war-room/POST_MORTEM.md && grep -q 'Action Items' /home/student/incident-war-room/POST_MORTEM.md && echo PASS || echo FAIL
